title: How Praying Out Loud With One Brother Changes a Godly Man
caption:
Most guys have never prayed out loud in front of another man. It feels awkward. That’s the point.

Out loud, you can’t stay vague. Your brother hears what you ask for and what you never mention. You start praying for his life, not just yours. And when he’s waiting on you every Thursday, you show up.

“Where two or three are gathered in my name, there am I among them.” Matthew 18:20

Text one brother and pick a day this week.
